paragraphs.en: Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.
paragraphs.zh: Claude-Mem 通过自动捕获工具使用观察、生成语义摘要，并使其可供未来会话使用，从而无缝地在会话之间保留上下文。 这使得 Claude 即使在会话结束或重新连接后，也能保持关于项目知识的连续性。

sents.en: This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.
sents.zh: 这使得 Claude 即使在会话结束或重新连接后，也能保持关于项目知识的连续性。

paragraphs.en: npx claude-mem install --ide grok-bot Grok Bot has no host hooks, so we watch the chat log files. Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory. Local observer is opt-in: --provider host . Installing this plugin does not install Cursor.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-mem install --ide grok-bot Grok Bot 没有宿主钩子，因此我们通过监视聊天日志文件来工作。 默认使用 CMEM Pro，即托管式记忆服务。 本地观察器为可选启用：--provider host。 安装此插件并不会安装 Cursor。

sents.en: Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory.
sents.zh: 默认使用 CMEM Pro，即托管式记忆服务。

sents.en: Local observer is opt-in: --provider host .
sents.zh: 本地观察器为可选启用：--provider host。

sents.en: Installing this plugin does not install Cursor.
sents.zh: 安装此插件并不会安装 Cursor。

paragraphs.en: Awareness push pilot (LFG + Orifice): needle observations ( decision , bugfix , security_alert , sensitive ) are appended as dated - YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] … lines into that bot's memory/log/YYYY-MM.md . Grok Bot already re-reads the log from disk. This does not write profile.md , user-memory, or project memory. Disable with CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=false .
paragraphs.zh: 认知推送试点（LFG + Orifice）：针式观察（decision、bugfix、security_alert、sensitive）会以带日期的 YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] … 行的形式追加到该智能体的 memory/log/YYYY-MM.md 中。 Grok 智能体已经会从磁盘重新读取该日志。 这不会写入 profile.md、用户记忆或项目记忆。 通过设置 CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=false 可禁用该功能。

paragraphs.en: npx claude-mem install The installer sets everything up first, then asks you to sign in to claude-mem in your browser (email magic link — no card required). Signing in provisions a memory key for your account and unlocks the claude-mem observer with a 30 Day Free Trial : memory runs off-plan, so you get up to 100% more usage from your plan. When the free trial ends, memory automatically falls back to your Anthropic plan unless you subscribe. After sign-in you pick your memory provider — the claude-mem observer, your own OpenRouter or Gemini key, or your Anthropic plan.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-mem install 安装程序会先完成所有设置，然后要求你在浏览器中登录 claude-mem（邮箱魔法链接——无需绑卡）。 登录后会为你的账户配置一个记忆密钥，并以 30 天免费试用解锁 claude-mem 观察器：记忆运行不占用套餐额度，因此你可以从套餐中获得多达 100% 的额外用量。 免费试用结束后，除非你订阅，否则记忆会自动回退到你的 Anthropic 套餐。 登录后你可以选择记忆提供商——claude-mem 观察器、你自己的 OpenRouter 或 Gemini 密钥，或你的 Anthropic 套餐。

paragraphs.en: Prefer to skip the sign-in? Pass an explicit --provider flag, set CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false , or run in CI/non-interactive shells — the installer completes without any account interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 更希望跳过登录？ 传入显式的 --provider 标志、设置 CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false，或在 CI/非交互式 shell 中运行——安装程序将在无需任何账号交互的情况下完成。

paragraphs.en: Or install for T3 Code (Codex and Claude Code providers):
paragraphs.zh: 或为 T3 Code（Codex 和 Claude Code 提供方）安装：

paragraphs.en: npx claude-mem install --ide t3code The installer discovers T3 Code's enabled providers, registers native Claude-Mem plugins in their configured homes, and supports T3-managed Codex. Restart T3 Code, trust the provider's hooks when prompted, and start a new thread. See the T3 Code integration guide for custom server settings, status, and removal.
paragraphs.zh: npx claude-mem install --ide t3code 安装程序会检测 T3 Code 已启用的提供商，在其配置目录中注册原生 Claude-Mem 插件，并支持由 T3 管理的 Codex。 重启 T3 Code，在提示时信任该提供商的钩子，然后开启一个新线程。 自定义服务器设置、状态查看与卸载方法，请参阅 T3 Code 集成指南。

paragraphs.en: Note: Claude-Mem is also published on npm, but npm install -g claude-mem installs the SDK/library only — it does not register the plugin hooks or set up the worker service. Always install via npx claude-mem install or the /plugin commands above.

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://install.cmem.ai/openclaw.sh | bash The installer handles dependencies, plugin setup, AI provider configuration, worker startup, and optional real-time observation feeds to Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more. See the OpenClaw Integration Guide for details.

paragraphs.en: Claude-Mem provides intelligent memory search through 4 MCP tools following a token-efficient 3-layer workflow pattern :
paragraphs.zh: Claude-Mem 通过 4 个 MCP 工具提供智能记忆搜索，遵循节省 token 的 3 层工作流模式：

paragraphs.en: // Step 1: Search for index search ( query = "authentication bug" , type = "bugfix" , limit = 10 ) // Step 2: Review index, identify relevant IDs (e.g., #123, #456) // Step 3: Fetch full details get_observations ( ids = [ 123 , 456 ] ) See Search Tools Guide for detailed examples.
paragraphs.zh: // 步骤 1：搜索索引 search ( query = "authentication bug" , type = "bugfix" , limit = 10 ) // 步骤 2：查看索引，识别相关 ID（例如 #123, #456） // 步骤 3：获取完整详情 get_observations ( ids = [ 123 , 456 ] ) 详见《搜索工具指南》中的详细示例。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code hooks do not need Git Bash. Each hook runs claude-mem directly, and npx claude-mem install places that launcher at %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-mem\bin\claude-mem.exe and adds the folder to your user Path. Restart your terminal or IDE afterwards so Claude Code picks up the new Path. If hooks report Executable not found in $PATH: "claude-mem" , run npx claude-mem doctor and see Troubleshooting .
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code 的钩子不需要 Git Bash。 每个钩子都直接运行 claude-mem，而 npx claude-mem install 会将该启动器放置在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-mem\bin\claude-mem.exe，并将该文件夹添加到你的用户 Path 中。 之后请重启你的终端或 IDE，以便 Claude Code 获取新的 Path。 如果钩子报告 Executable not found in $PATH: "claude-mem"，请运行 npx claude-mem doctor 并参阅「故障排除」部分。

paragraphs.en: To include observations from every harness in Claude Code and Codex SessionStart context, set "CLAUDE_MEM_SESSION_START_INCLUDE_ALL_SOURCES": "true" in that file, or enable Include all sources at session start in the viewer settings. The default is "false" , which limits startup context to the current harness. The observation count limit still applies across the selected sources.
paragraphs.zh: 若要在 Claude Code 与 Codex 的 SessionStart 上下文中包含来自所有工具环境的观察记录，请在该文件中设置 "CLAUDE_MEM_SESSION_START_INCLUDE_ALL_SOURCES": "true"，或在查看器设置中启用「会话启动时包含所有来源」。 默认值为 "false"，即将启动上下文限制为当前工具环境。 观察记录的数量上限仍然适用于所选的所有来源。

sents.en: The default is "false" , which limits startup context to the current harness.

sents.en: The observation count limit still applies across the selected sources.

paragraphs.en: Claude-Mem supports multiple workflow modes and languages via the CLAUDE_MEM_MODE setting.
paragraphs.zh: Claude-Mem 通过 CLAUDE_MEM_MODE 设置支持多种工作流模式和语言。

paragraphs.en: Edit your settings file at ~/.claude-mem/settings.json :
paragraphs.zh: 编辑位于 ~/.claude-mem/settings.json 的设置文件：

paragraphs.en: { "CLAUDE_MEM_MODE" : " code--zh " } Modes are defined in plugin/modes/ . To see all available modes locally:
paragraphs.zh: { "CLAUDE_MEM_MODE" : " code--zh " } 模式定义在 plugin/modes/ 目录中。 要在本地查看所有可用模式：

sents.en: { "CLAUDE_MEM_MODE" : " code--zh " } Modes are defined in plugin/modes/ .
sents.zh: { "CLAUDE_MEM_MODE" : " code--zh " } 模式定义在 plugin/modes/ 目录中。

sents.en: To see all available modes locally:
sents.zh: 要在本地查看所有可用模式：

paragraphs.en: ls ~ /.claude/plugins/marketplaces/thedotmack/plugin/modes/ Available Modes Mode Description code Default English mode code--zh Simplified Chinese mode code--ja Japanese mode Language-specific modes follow the pattern code--[lang] where [lang] is the ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., zh for Chinese, ja for Japanese, es for Spanish).
paragraphs.zh: ls ~ /.claude/plugins/marketplaces/thedotmack/plugin/modes/ 可用模式 模式 描述 code 默认英文模式 code--zh 简体中文模式 code--ja 日语模式 特定语言模式遵循 code--[lang] 的命名模式，其中 [lang] 是 ISO 639-1 语言代码（例如，zh 表示中文，ja 表示日语，es 表示西班牙语）。

paragraphs.en: Note: code--zh (Simplified Chinese) is already built-in — no additional installation or plugin update is required.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：code--zh（简体中文）已内置——无需额外安装或更新插件。
